metadata.description: Phase 4: Site server (accounts, history, chrono registry, scheduling and registration, club profiles, remote setup) and advanced play (Master and Satellites, Target Windows, VIP / Payload, Hacking Terminal, custom scenarios, ATAK/CoT). Gate: a weekend milsim runs on Atalaia end to end.
metadata.next_plan_phase: 20 (scenario library and game history on the site server), then 21 and 22
metadata.resume_note: Plan phase 1 (Master and Satellites) built in software 2026-10-19 (decisions M1-1 to M1-6, open). Plan phase 2 (Target Windows logic, game.teams(), the hit capability) and the Field Box picker's pages built in software 2026-10-19 (decisions M2-1 to M2-5, open); the target addon is HW2. Refreshed 2026-10-19 against phase 3's software. Plan phases 1-9 (modes, core, scenarios, ATAK) and 10-22 (site server) are independent chains; HW1-HW4 wait for the Heltec V4 boards, the target addon, phones and phase 2 F / phase 3 G. Decisions P4R1-P4R26 are open. Plan phase 10 (site server skeleton and its test tooling) built in software on 2026-10-19; decisions S10-1 to S10-12 open. Plan phase 11 (accounts, sessions and roles) built in software on 2026-10-19; decisions S11-1 to S11-15 open. Plan phase 12 (personal data rights, consent records, retention purge; lockout per address and username) built in software on 2026-10-20; decisions S12-1 to S12-8 open. Plan phase 3 (geo utilities: geo.distance, geo.in_zone, bit-identical on every platform) built in software 2026-10-20; decisions M3-1 to M3-3 open. Plan phase 13 (controller sync: migration 0004_sync, controller store schema 5, protocol/sync.md) built in software on 2026-10-20; over a real 4G link is HW1; decisions S13-1 to S13-12 open. Plan phase 4 (Hacking Terminal: code, wires and sequence puzzles on the keypad, hacking.solved 47, puzzle key 36, the 11th Field Box preset) built in software 2026-10-20; decisions M4-1 to M4-9 open. Plan phase 14 (chrono registry: migration 0005_chrono, controller store schema 6) built in software on 2026-10-20; decisions S14-1 to S14-12 open. Plan phase 5 (VIP / Payload, vip.extracted 46, the 12th Field Box preset; gm_only data and params stripped from player views, M4-7/M5-1) built in software 2026-10-20; decisions M5-1 to M5-7 open. Plan phase 15 (scheduling, public field pages, iCalendar and JSON feeds; migration 0006_scheduling) built in software on 2026-10-20; decisions S15-1 to S15-15 open. Plan phase 6 (kind: scenario packages over the org.atalaia.objectives role package, events 42-45, data keys 34-35, the 13th Field Box preset) built in software 2026-10-20; decisions M6-1 to M6-9 open. Plan phase 16 (registration with pre-declared replicas and check-in tickets, roster pull and outcomes push; migration 0007_registration, controller store schema 7; the app's registration screens not built, S16-13) built in software on 2026-10-20; decisions S16-1 to S16-14 open. Plan phase 7 (scenario compiler, validator and CLI in controller/atalaia_controller/scenarios/) built in software 2026-10-20; decisions M7-1 to M7-9 open. Plan phase 9 (ATAK / CoT emitter: atak.py, georef.py, PUT /api/v1/field/georef, the console's map position, protocol/vectors/cot.json) built in software 2026-10-20; a real ATAK device is HW3; decisions M9-1 to M9-10 open.
metadata.handoff_applied: 2026-10-18 (phase 2 A-E complete, phase 3 design complete); refreshed 2026-10-19 (phase 3 software built)
